newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Ballston Spa CSD, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ballston Spa CSD, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
Ballston Spa Central School District
Saratoga County, New York
School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997
(Book Entry Only) (Not Bank Qualified)

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by the President of the Board of Education of Ballston Spa Central School District, Saratoga County, New York, at the Office of Lemery & Reid, P.C., 10 Railroad Place, Saratoga Springs, New York 12866, Attn: Karen S. Martell, until 11:00 o'clock A.M., Prevailing Time on the
25th day of June, 1997,

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $32,400,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, of said School District, dated June 1, 1997, and maturing in annual principal installments which, together with interest thereon, are expected to provide for

substantially level or declining annual debt service on the Bonds, as defined and described in paragraph d of Section 21.00 of the New York Local Finance Law as follows: $1,600,000 on June 1, 1998, $685,000 on June 1, 1999, $840,000 on June 1, 2000, $890,000 on June 1, 2001, $940,000 on June 1, 2002, $995,000 on June 1, 2003, $1,050,000 on June 1, 2004, $1,115,000 on June 1, 2005, $1,175,000 on June 1, 2006, $1,245,000 on June 1, 2007, $1,315,000 on June 1, 2008, $1,390,000 on June 1, 2009, $1,470,000 on June 1, 2010, $1,555,000 on June 1, 2011, $1,645,000 on June 1, 2012, and $1,740,000 on June 1, 2013, $1,840,000 on June 1, 2014, $1,945,000 on June 1, 2015, $2,055,000 on June 1, 2016, $2,175,000 on June 1, 2017, $2,300,000 on June 1, 2018, $2,435,000 on June 1, 2019, with interest thereon payable on December 1, 1997 and semi-annually thereafter on June 1 and December 1 (the Bonds'').

THE SCHOOL DISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE MUNIFACTS WIRE.

Bonds maturing on or before June 1, 2006 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. Bonds maturing on or after June 1, 2007 are subject to redemption, at the option of the School District, prior to maturity, in whole or in part, on any interest payment date on or after June 1, 2006, at redemption prices, expressed as a percentage of par, plus accrued interest to the redemption date, as follows: June 1, 2006 and December 1, 2006, 102%, June 1, 2007 and December 1, 2007, 101%, and June 1, 2008 and thereafter, 100%.
The Bonds will be initially issued in registered form in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities

depository for the Bonds. The Bonds will bear interes the rate or rates per annum in multiples of one-eighth or one-hundredth of one per centum specified by the successful bidder. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest true interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. A good faith deposit in the amount of $648,000 should accompany each bid. The purchaser will be furnished without cost, the
unqualified legal opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of Lemery & Reid, P.C., Saratoga Springs, New York, Bond Counsel.

For further information regarding the Bonds and to obtain copies of the complete Notice of Bond Sale, Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official Statement of the School District, please contact Public Finance Associates, Inc., telephone: (914) 227-8678, telecopier: (914) 227-6154.
Dated: Ballston Spa, New York
Paul A. DeCotis
President of the Board of Education
(From The Bond Buyer)
